enum controls how edition thumbnails are sized and
positioned within their containers across archive, bookmarks, downloads, and
splash screens. This is one of the most impactful visual customization points
— it determines the layout feel of your archive grid.
There are three modes:
— the image fills the container’s width
and is cropped vertically if the aspect ratio differs. This is the default
for archives, bookmarks, and downloads.
— the image fills the container’s
height and is cropped horizontally if needed. This is the default for the
reader splash screen.
— the image
fills the container’s width while the cell height adjusts dynamically to
preserve the image’s natural aspect ratio. Provide an
to stabilize layout during loading; the SDK refines it automatically once
